text:
lena-partners: Quick update  PhoenixCare renewed and expanded their Dedicated commit for another 24 months and agreed to a marketplace listing on Azure. They want a joint case study after 45 days of steady traffic. :tada:

omar-sales: Amazing news! Any changes to their compliance asks?

lena-partners: Slight tweak  theyre asking for customer-managed KMS + a longer audit retention (2 years). Also requested a short technical appendix explaining our batching + caching benefits for cost.

gina-marketing: I'll own the case study draft. Need a 1-sentence CTO quote and a 2-line technical blurb from engineering by EOD Wed. Also need logo permission — PhoenixCare approved on email.

devin-eng: Can do. Draft tech blurb: "p95 token latency <55ms on reserved g5/g6 pools for typical EHR summarization flows; batching + KV cache reduces per-token cost ~30% vs baseline." Tiny python snippet for the appendix: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='REDACTED')
print(client.generate(model='rwd-summarize-1', prompt='Summarize recent visit').text)
```

sasha-sec: From security: we'll need a signed BAA addendum and KMS key policy review. Recommend HSM-backed CMKs if they require key isolation. I'll attach the checklist to the kickoff invite.

pm-bot: Onboarding ticket PC-7201 created and assigned to devin-eng, sasha-sec. ETA 5 days.

omar-sales: Marketing note  let's aim to publish the case study 2 weeks after go-live. Gina, I'll coordinate a short quote from PhoenixCare CTO and intro the exec.

gina-marketing: Thanks  looping in PR and comms. Drop any one-liners about "why PhoenixCare picked Redwood" here for the case study blurb.

lena-partners: One-liner: "Chose Redwood for predictable reserved pricing, private deployment options, and proven latency for clinical summarization."

devin-eng: I'll also include a 1-paragraph appendix describing the Dedicated connector and marketplace quickstart for the listing.

sasha-sec: Uploaded BAA template + KMS integration guide to ticket PC-7201.

lena-partners: Kickoff scheduled Thu 9am PT. Agenda: intros, compliance checklist, infra plan, case study timeline. Great job team! :raised_hands:
